development_findings.detail: Manually removing rigid model invalidated coupled goal native hash. Harness now recomputes binding, core check retained.
Development used nonexistent station reservation_required and bus safe_exit_soc attributes; corrected to supported ground profile and recovery_soc before qualification.
Mutated release/quota cases needed updated coupled goal hash; no native binding check weakened.
Direct script could not import examples namespace. Fixed by declaring identical geographic inputs locally; all three frozen JSON specs checked unchanged.
Independent shifted case predicts and realizes zero of 24. Case retained with failed goal and no SFT. No geometry or floor search performed.
